text:
Let me re-read the problem carefully.

"Robyn sends sixteen emails a day. Seven are work emails, and two-thirds of the remainder are to family. One-third of the other emails are to her boyfriend."

Step 1: Total emails = 16, Work emails = 7
Remainder = 16 - 7 = 9 emails

Step 2: Two-thirds of the remainder (9) go to family
Family emails = (2/3) × 9 = 6 emails

Step 3: "The other emails" = 9 - 6 = 3 emails
One-third of these go to boyfriend = (1/3) × 3 = 1 email

**Final answer: Robyn sends 1 email a day to her boyfriend.**

content.text:
I need to find how many emails Robyn sends to her boyfriend.

Given information:
- Total emails per day: 16
- Work emails: 7
- The remainder (16 - 7 = 9) split into two groups:
  - Two-thirds to family
  - One-third to boyfriend

Wait, let me re-read. "Two-thirds of the remainder are to family. One-third of the other emails are to her boyfriend."

The remainder is 16 - 7 = 9 emails.
- Two-thirds of the remainder (9) go to family: (2/3) × 9 = 6 emails to family
- The "other emails" (from the remainder) = 9 - 6 = 3 emails
- One-third of these 3 go to boyfriend: (1/3) × 3 = 1 email

**Robyn sends 1 email a day to her boyfriend.**
